name: personlogy-hook
description: Capture personal signals from Codex prompts into a local durable SQLite outbox.

interface.shortDescription: Capture personal signals into a local PersonLogy outbox.
interface.longDescription: PersonLogy Hook captures selected Codex user prompts, stores redacted evidence in SQLite, and retries delivery to a configured PersonLogy endpoint.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me inspect or configure the PersonLogy Hook outbox.
